queries.name: command-queue
queries.subject: Show the durable local CLI command queue.
queries.objective: Inspect command lifecycle and reconnect to output without rerunning work.
queries.acceptance: Preserve persistent command IDs and all six server states; closing output never cancels execution. Unavailable local authority is not an empty queue.

pages.intent: Determine which durable local command needs attention.
pages.subject: Durable commands in the connected local control repository.
pages.objective: Reconnect to one existing command without executing it again.
pages.acceptance: Show persistent IDs, native states, targets, timestamps and errors; distinguish unavailable authority from an empty queue. Navigation must not cancel work.
pages.title: Commands
pages.description: Reconnect to a durable local command without rerunning it.

views.title: Commands
views.description: Lazy-loaded command cards with persistent status and replayable output. Filters and pages execute on the local server through the data worker.

pages.intent: Inspect the selected command's execution and retained output before deciding whether to retry.
pages.subject: One command selected by the command route parameter.
pages.objective: Understand execution results without treating terminal output as instructions.
pages.acceptance: Preserve stdout/stderr, command identity, state and errors; report missing output honestly. Leaving detaches only; retries require explicit approval.
pages.title: Command output
pages.description: Decide whether the selected command needs an explicit retry.

views.title: Command output
views.description: Edge-to-edge terminal replay starting with the executed command, ANSI colors preserved on stdout and stderr, persistent pull-request results, and floating copy and retry actions. Interaction-only streaming and retry use worker transport; navigating away only detaches.
